x-m-el-job-02.title: Kutaura Kumhanya Kumwechete Nezvikamu Zviviri
x-m-el-job-02.goal: Uchishandisa kushandura pakati pekumhanya paminetsi (m) nekumhanya paawa (km), wana iwe pachako mamiriro apo mitengo yose miviri i natural numbers, uye utsanangure nei.
x-m-el-job-02.material: Vanhu vaviri mu running club vakatsanangura kumhanya kumwechete nezvikamu zvakasiyana. Mumwe akati 'x m paminetsi' (distance yakafamba mu minute 1), uye mumwe akati 'y km paawa' (distance yakafamba mu awa 1). Vanoda kutaura nhamba senatural numbers chete, pasina ma decimals kana ma fractions.
x-m-el-job-02.thinking.1: Gadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inogutsa mamiriro
x-m-el-job-02.prereq.1: Kumhanya kunoratidzwa se distance yakafamba mu nguva imwechete (middle school level)
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.prompt: Kumhanya kwemunhu anomhanya pa 6 km paawa i anenge ma m mangani paminetsi? Tanga wafungidzira hukuru.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga washandura distance yakafamba mu awa 1 kuita m.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.hint.1: Govanisa distance iyoyo ne maminetsi 60 kuti ufungidzire distance yakafamba mu minute 1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.r.a: Tarisa kana inotora anenge maminetsi 10 kufamba 1 km. Tarisa direction yaunochinja nayo zvikamu.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.r.c: 1000 m paminetsi inoenderana ne 60 km paawa. Tarisa ratio ye minute 1 ku awa 1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.explain: 6 km paawa i 6000 m mu awa 1, uye awa 1 i maminetsi 60, saka i anenge 100 m mu minute 1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya 3 akasiyana enatural numbers, kumhanya paminetsi x (m) nekumhanya paawa y (km), anoita kumhanya kumwechete. Kumhanya paawa i kubva ku 6 kusvika ku 20 pamwe chete (renji yaunogona kumhanya munhu).
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.0: Taura distance yakafamba mu awa 1 pa x m paminetsi mu km.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzirisa kumhanya kumwe paawa uye utarise kana kumhanya paminetsi i natural number.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.2: Kana dzimwe nzira dzekumhanya paawa dzisingapi natural numbers, tsvaga chii chakafanana mudzo.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c1: x ne y zvinofanira kuva natural numbers.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c2: x m paminetsi ne y km paawa hazvisi kumhanya kumwechete. Enzanisa distance yakafamba mu awa 1 muchikamu chimwechete.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Kumhanya paawa kunofanira kuva kubva ku 6 kusvika ku 20 pamwe chete.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.explain: 100 m paminetsi i 6000 m mu awa 1, saka i 6 km paawa. Nguva imwe neimwe kumhanya paminetsi kunowedzera ne 50 m, kumhanya paawa kunowedzera ne 3 km. Saka 100/6, 150/9, 200/12, 250/15, 300/18 i mapeya anogoneka.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura nei 7 km kana 8 km paawa zvisingashande, asi 6, 9 ne 12 km zvichishanda.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kana ukashandura y km paawa kuita kumhanya paminetsi, inova fraction. Ona kuti y inofanira kuva yakaita sei kuti denominator igovanisike zvakanaka.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Verenga kumhanya paminetsi kwe 7 ne 8 zvakananga, uye uwane nei dzichiva ma decimals.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana ukashandura kumhanya paawa kuita kumhanya paminetsi, ...
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa kuti mapeya awakagadzira anotevera mutemo mumwechete here?
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura chikonzero chemutemo nekubvunza 'nei 3 (kana 50) chaizvo?' here?
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.0: y km paawa mukumhanya paminetsi i 1000×y÷60 = 50y/3 m. Kuti iyi ive natural number, y inofanira kuva multiple ye 3, saka 6, 9, 12 zvinoshanda uye 7, 8 hazvishande.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.1: x m paminetsi i 60x m = 0.06x km mu awa 1. Kuti zvose zviri zviviri ve integers, x inofanira kuva multiple ye 50, uye ipapo kumhanya paawa kunokwira ne 3 nguva imwe neimwe.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Kushandura kumhanya y paawa kuita paminetsi kunopa 50y/3, saka y inofanira kugovaniswa ne 3 kuti ive natural number. 6, 9, ne 12 zvinoshanda, uye 7 ne 8 hazvishande.

x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva imwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, ita kutonga kwako neruzivo kusvika panguva iyoyo.
x-m-el-job-10.title: Kusarudza Phone Plan: Ruzivo Rwemwedzi Mumwe Rwunokwana here?
x-m-el-job-10.goal: Dzidza kuti data yemwedzi mumwe kana miviri haikwani kusarudza plan, uye kuti plan iri nani inochinja kana kushandisa kuchichinja, uye uwane muganhu.
x-m-el-job-10.material: Unoda kushandisa imwe yema phone plans maviri kubva zvino. Plan A inodhura 30,000원 pamwedzi uye ine data kusvika ku10 GB, ne5,000원 pa GB iri pamusoro. Plan B inodhura 42,000원 pamwedzi uye ine data isingaperi. Kushandisa kunoverengwa mu GB dzakazara chete.
x-m-el-job-10.thinking.0: Gadzirisa kutonga kwako kana ruzivo rwuchikura
x-m-el-job-10.prereq.0: Kutaura mitengo nemitauro yelinear (chiyero chechikoro chepakati)
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora mitengo yema plans ose maviri mwedzi mumwe nemumwe uye ufananidze huwandu hwose.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti kushandisa kuri padhuze nepi apo mitengo yaA naB inova yakaenzana.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Kushandisa data kwemwedzi wapfuura kwaiva 9 GB.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kana ukasarudza plan yekushandisa kubva zvino, ungatonga sei?
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Ne9 GB mwedzi wapfuura, A i30,000원 uye B i42,000원, saka A inodhura shoma. Asi iyi idata yemwedzi mumwe chete.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kuzorora kwakasiyana nekudhura shoma. Verenga mutengo wemwedzi wapfuura pama plans ose maviri.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A: zvichibva pamwedzi wapfuura, inodhura shoma
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Idata yemwedzi mumwe chete, saka zvichiri zvakaoma kusarudza
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Mwedzi uno wakaona mavhidhiyo mazhinji ukashandisa 12 GB.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Neruzivo rwemwedzi miviri iyi, ungagadzirisa sei kutonga kwako?
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Ne12 GB, A i30,000 + 2×5,000 = 40,000원, iri kudhura shoma pane B (42,000원). Kunyange kana ukapfuura, B haiva iri nani nekukurumidza.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Chengeta A: yaidhura shoma mwedzi uno futi
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Chinjira ku B: wakapfuura 10 GB, saka B iri nani zvino
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kupfuura 10 GB hakuiti kuti B ive nani nekukurumidza. Verenga mutengo wehuwandu hwekuwedzera.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Data yemwedzi miviri ichiri pakutanga zvakanyanya
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Kushandisa kunotarisirwa kwemwedzi 4 inotevera i8 GB, 13 GB, 14 GB ne15 GB.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ndeipi plan ine mutengo wose wakaderera pamwedzi 4 iyi?
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.after: A i30,000 + 45,000 + 50,000 + 55,000 = 180,000원 uye B i42,000×4 = 168,000원. A yaiita seyakachipa mumwedzi miviri yekutanga, asi kana mwedzi ine kushandisa kwakawedzera yakasanganiswa, B inodhura shoma.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kungova A inodhura shoma mune dzimwe mwedzi hakureve kuti huwandu hwayo hwunodhura shoma. Verenga mutengo waA mwedzi mumwe nemumwe uye uuwedzere.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kutonga kuti zvakafanana usati wawana huwandu hwose hakuna humbowo.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.reflect: Nedata yemwedzi mumwe nemwedzi miviri, A yaiita seyakanaka, asi kana waona kugovera kwekushandisa kunotevera, kutonga kwako kwakachinja. Funga kuti ndeupi ruzivo rwakawanda rwaunoda usati wagadzika kutonga kwako, uye kuti plan iri nani inochinja pakushandisa kupi.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira makoshero 2 akasiyana ekushandisa kwemwedzi x GB apo Plan B inodhura shoma kupfuura Plan A. (x inhamba yakazara kubva ku0 kusvika ku40)
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga mutengo waA nenzira kune x=10, 11, 12, 13.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga kuti x iri kupi apo mutengo waA unotanga kupfuura 42,000원.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.fail.c1: x inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara kubva ku0 kusvika ku40.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Pakushandisa uku, A inodhura shoma kana kuenzana neB. Wedzera mutengo wehuwandu hwekuwedzera futi.
x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.explain: Mutengo waA i30,000 + 5,000×(x−10). Unopfuura 42,000원 kana x iri 13 kana kupfuura. Pa x=12 i40,000원 uye A ichiri kudhura shoma, uye pa13 i45,000원 uye B inova inodhura shoma.

x-m-el-job-05.title: Kuenzanisa Kurongeka Kwemipiro Nemamiriro
x-m-el-job-05.goal: Gadzira kurongeka kwemipiro kunogutsa mamiriro ose, uye utsanangure kuti wakaverenga sei huwandu hwose hwekurongeka kunogoneka pasina kusiya.
x-m-el-job-05.material:
Pa stage yemutambo, makirabhu A, B, C ne D imwe neimwe inoita kamwe chete, imwe shure kweimwe. Mamiriro ndeaya.
① A haigoni kuva yekutanga nekuda kwekugadzirira zvishandiso.
② D haigoni kuva yekupedzisira nekuda kwechimwe chakazvipira.
③ Vhidhiyo ya B ndiyo background yemupiro wa C, saka B inofanira kuita pamberi pe C.
Nhamba yekurongeka 1 ndiyo yekutanga uye 4 ndiyo yekupedzisira.
x-m-el-job-05.thinking.2: Tsanangura kuti wakava nechokwadi sei nehuwandu
x-m-el-job-05.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekuti kurongedza zvinhu 4 mumutsara kunoita kurongeka kwakasiyana
x-m-el-job-05.prereq.1: Zvakakosha zvekuverenga nekuparadzanisa (nhanho ye sum rule)
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.prompt: Kana mamiriro ③ (B pamberi pe C) chete akachengetwa, pane kurongeka kwemipiro kwakawanda sei kwemakirabhu 4 zvose?
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga rangarira kuti pane kurongeka kwakawanda sei pasina mamiriro chaiwo.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa zvinoitika kana ukachinjanisa nzvimbo dza B ne C mukurongeka.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.r.a: Hazvioneswe kuti mamiriro ③ anogumira kurongeka.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.r.b: Tarisa shure kuti wakaverenga sei kuti hukama hwekutangira nekutevera hwa B ne C hwakatarwa se imwe yembiri.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s1.explain: Pane kurongeka 24 kwemakirabhu 4 zvose, uye kuchinjanisa mapeya ekutangira nekutevera e B ne C kunoaisa mapeya. Hafu chaiyo yazvo, nzira 12, inogutsa mamiriro ③.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira kurongeka 3 kwemipiro kwakasiyana kunogutsa mamiriro ose matatu. a, b, c ne d ndenhamba dzekurongeka (1 kusvika ku4) dza A, B, C ne D zvichiteerana. Nhamba dzemakirabhu mana dzinofanira kusiyana dzose.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nekuisa kirabhu ine zvirambidzo zvakawanda zvakanyanya.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga kuti chii chinoitika kunzvimbo dzakasara kana ukaisa B pa1.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.hint.2: Mushure mekugadzira kurongeka, chitarise nemamiriro ①, ② ne ③ rimwe rimwe.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Zvose ndenhamba dzakasikwa kubva ku1 kusvika ku4.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba dzekurongeka dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzakasikwa kubva ku1 kusvika ku4.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Makirabhu maviri haagoni kushandisa kurongeka kumwe chete.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.fail.c3: A haigoni kuva panzvimbo yekutanga (mamiriro ①).
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.fail.c4: D haigoni kuva panzvimbo yekupedzisira (mamiriro ②).
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.fail.c5: B inofanira kuita pamberi pe C (mamiriro ③).
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.explain: Pane kurongeka 7 zvose kunogutsa mamiriro. Kwakanyorwa sekurongeka, ndi BADC, BCDA, BDAC, BDCA, DABC, DBAC, DBCA. Semuenzaniso, BADC zvinoreva A=2, B=1, C=4, D=3.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsvaga kuti pane kurongeka kwakawanda sei kunogoneka zvose, uye unyore nzira yakakuita kuti uve nechokwadi chekuti hauna kusiya chero kumwe.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tarisa kuti pane nyaya dzingani kana ukaparadzanisa nekirabhu inogona kuva panzvimbo yekutanga.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Munyaya imwe neimwe, nyora rimwe rimwe kuti ungaise sei makirabhu matatu akasara kuti agutse mamiriro.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kuti nzira yako yekuverenga haiverengi kurongeka kumwe chete kaviri?
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Kurongeka 3 kwawakagadzira kuri pakati pe7 kwawakaverenga here?
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ukaparadzanisa kuva nyaya apo B iri yekutanga ine nzira 4 nenyaya apo D iri yekutanga ine nzira 3, pane 7 zvose.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Kubva panzira 12 apo B iri pamberi pe C, bvisa 3 apo A iri yekutanga, wobva wabvisa 2 dzimwe apo D iri yekupedzisira, uye 7 dzinosara.
x-m-el-job-05.s.s2.because.model.2: Paradzanisa nechikwata chinogona kuva chekutanga. Kana B iri yekutanga pane nzira 4, uye kana D iri yekutanga pane nzira 3, saka pane nzira 7 zvose.

x-m-el-job-06.title: Kugadzirisa Mhinduro Yekuverenga Ma Schedule Emabasa
x-m-el-job-06.goal: Paradzanisa nyaya dzine kurongeka kubva kune dzisina kurongeka, tsvaga nekugadzirisa kukanganisa mumhinduro inoverenga kugoverwa kwema schedule, uye utarise uchishandisa imwe nzira.
x-m-el-job-06.material: Pazuva re field trip, unosarudza 3 pamabasa 5 (A, B, C, D, E) uye unopa rimwe nerimwe kuna mangwanani, masikati nemanheru. Basa A riri kunze, saka haringaitwi manheru. Mudzidzi akagadzirisa kuti pane ma assignment mangani anogoneka zvose.
x-m-el-job-06.thinking.1: Paradzanisa kuti kurongeka kunokosha here uye ugadzirise
x-m-el-job-06.prereq.0: Mutemo we product (kuverenga nekuwedzera sarudzo dzakaitwa mumanhanho akawanda)
x-m-el-job-06.prereq.1: Zvakakosha zvehuwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza dzimwe kubva pazvinhu zvakasiyana n
x-m-el-job-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara apo mhinduro yemudzidzi inotanga kukanganisa.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga funga kuti schedule ine basa X mangwanani nebasa Y masikati ndiyo schedule imwe chete neine Y mangwanani ne X masikati here.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa mutsara nemutsara nenzira yakarongeka kuti chiyero ichocho chinoshandiswa nenzira imwe chete mumitsara yose yemhinduro here.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s1.line.0: Tinosarudza 3 pa5 uye tinoaisa kumangwanani, masikati nemanheru, saka 5×4×3 = 60 nzira.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s1.line.1: Verenga nyaya apo A yakapihwa manheru. Huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza mabasa 2 emangwanani nemasikati kubva kune mamwe 4 ndi (4×3)÷2 = 6.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s1.line.2: Saka huwandu hwenyaya apo A isina kupihwa manheru ndi60 − 6 = 54 nzira.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 hauna kururama. Mangwanani nemasikati inguva dzakasiyana, saka kunyangwe mabasa maviri akafanana anoita ma schedule akasiyana zvichienderana nekuti ndeipi iri mangwanani. Asi mutsara uyu unoparadzanisa (4×3) ne2, uchiverenga pasina kusiyanisa kurongeka, saka kukosha kunodzikira nehafu.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga huwandu hwakarurama hwenzira, uye uratidze kuti imwe nzira (senge kusarudza nguva yemanheru kutanga) inopa kukosha kwakafanana.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga nekuwedzera nzira dzekuzadza nzvimbo dzemangwanani nemasikati imwe imwe munyaya apo A iri manheru.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kusarudza nguva yemanheru kutanga wobva wazadza zvimwe.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Mangwanani nemasikati zvine kurongeka, saka ...
x-m-el-job-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kuti kukosha kwenzira imwe kunoenzana ne48?
x-m-el-job-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here chikonzero chekuparadzanisa mangwanani nemasikati uchishandisa mamiriro e schedule?
x-m-el-job-06.s.s2.model.0: Mangwanani nemasikati zvine kurongeka, saka haufaniri kuparadzanisa ne2, uye ndi4×3 = 12. Saka 60 − 12 = 48.
x-m-el-job-06.s.s2.model.1: Kumanheru, tinosarudza rimwe pa4 risiri A, iro rinova nzira 4, uye nzira dzekuisa mangwanani nemasikati kubva pa4 yakasara ndi4×3, saka 4×4×3 = 48 nzira.

x-m-el-job-09.title: Kutengesa Macookies: Chii Chimwe Chatinofanira Kuziva Kuti Tiverenge?
x-m-el-job-09.goal: Tonga kana unogona kuverenga neruzivo rwakapiwa mudambudziko chete, sarudza ruzivo rwuri kushaikwa, uye uwane mhedziso neruzivo rutsva.
x-m-el-job-09.material: Kirabhu inoronga kutengesa macookies akagadzirwa nemaoko pafestival, ese pa1,500원 rimwe nerimwe. Vatoshandisa 36,000원 pazvinhu zvekugadzira. Mutungamiri wekirabhu akabvunza, 'Ndapota verenga kuti tinofanira kutengesa mangani kuti tisarasikirwa.'
x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvose zvausati waziva usati wagona kuverenga.
x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora seformula kuti zvinhu zvipi zvinogadzira purofiti uye zvipi zvinobviswa.
x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana formula inochinja nekana isina ruzivo rwesarudzo imwe neimwe.
x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.o.a: Kana pane mamwe mari yakagadzikana kunze kwemutengo wezvinhu zvekugadzira, seye booth fee
x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.r.b: Kana macookies ose ane mutengo mumwe chete, huwandu hwemhando hahukanganisi purofiti kana kurasikirwa. Funga kuti ruzivo rupi runochinja purofiti nekurasikirwa.
x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.o.c: Kana pane mutengo wakasiyana wekurongedza nguva imwe neimwe cookie ichitengeswa
x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.r.d: Huwandu hwakagadzirirwa hunodiwa kuona 'kana zvichigoneka mukati meizvozvo.' Funga kana zvichidiwa chaizvo kuwana huwandu hwakaderera zvikuru hwekutengesa kuti usarasikirwa.
x-m-el-job-09.s.s1.explain: Kuti usarasikirwa, (mutengo wekutengesa pacookie imwe − mutengo wekuwedzera pacookie imwe) wakawanzwa nehuwandu hwakatengeswa unofanira kuva wakaenzana kana pamusoro pemari yose yakagadzikana. Saka unofanira kuziva mari yakagadzikana (booth fee nezvimwe) nemutengo wekuwedzera pacookie imwe (kurongedza). x-m-el-job-08.material: Uri kuisa ma tile e square ane mativi e30 cm pasi reimba ine hurefu 3.6 m nehupamhi 4.1 m. Ma tile anotengeswa mumabhokisi e10 chete, uye bhokisi rimwe rinodhura 18,000 won. Tile imwe neimwe inoshandiswa seimwe yakazara, uye kurasika kwekucheka hakufungwi. Pazasi ndiyo mhinduro yefungidziro yemudzidzi.
